LanguageData.Gun_G3_RWP.label: G3
LanguageData.Gun_G3_RWP.description: A robust and versatile battle rifle, the G3 fires 7.62x51mm NATO rounds. Known for its reliability and accuracy, it excels at medium to long-range combat, making it a favored choice among military forces worldwide. Its high stopping power is balanced by moderate recoil and a slower firing rate compared to other firearms.
